main_measure.name: mean timing gain per case (position x next-day excess return)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check < 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 cases on 100 distinct days

supporting_check.name: deeper-half minus shallower-half mean next-day excess return (split at median |forecast|)

decided_by: The t of the mean timing gain lies between -2 and 2, so the result is inconclusive.
reading: Cases are bars with a nonzero position after the trade and a next close in the same window; the t sums each day's deviations across coins into one piece of evidence; the deeper half is |forecast| strictly above the median, the shallower half at or below it; the choppy profile is read from the detector's regime column, the down close from the prices.
